title: [CS2] ZE OBF NPST
description:
The CS2 NPST.

Credit:
作者
Map original made by Trazix in Garry's Mod.
地图原作者Trazix，于Gmod创作。

CS2 Map port and completely remade by Nino.
地图由Nino重置于CS2

Gameplay Guide:
游玩指南
1.Highest graphic settings in game.(if not, the 8K lightmap will not be visible)
将游戏画质设置为最高（如果没有设置为最高，将无法展现8k的光照效果）
2.At least 50% of music volume, by press ~ on keyboard to console and type snd_musicvolume 50.
最低50%的音乐音量，控制台输入snd_musicvolume 50

Past version:
过去的版本
CS-GO were port by Huishnya and further updated by Kotya(v2) and Nino(v1)
Gmod were updated by Koen and Jaek
CS-GO版本由Huishnya移植，并由Kotya更新为V2，Nino更新为V1
Gmod版本由Koen和Jaek更新.

CS2 changes:
CS2更新内容

<8K Lightmaps Resolution with Final quality compiled.>
100% remake of Textures, created _normals, _ao, _roughness for main used textures.
100% remake of lights, developd and improved all lighting & reflections (cubemaps).
100% updated Arts (Decals, Lights) and Landscape Architecture (Model and Meshes rebuilt.)
50% of models ported, another 50% replaced with CS2 official models, (they are better).
Developed and improved particles and building better map game-play performance (Thanks Seth for help).
100% sound and music remake.
Remake game-play logic to adapt to CS2.
<No any different game-play with CS-GO v1>
<Nihilanth Boss fight will be updated in the future>

<8K光照分辨率和最高品质地图编译.>
100% 贴图重置, 给主要的贴图制作了反射, _ao, _roughness.
100% 灯光重置, 制作并提升所有灯光效果品质，以及反射(cubemaps).
100% 美术效果的提升 (Decals, Lights) 与造景的制作 (Model and Meshes rebuilt.)
50% 模型移植, 另外 50%使用CS2官方的模型（因为它们质量更好）.
100%的音效和音乐重置。
制作并更新粒子特效，并且制作更多更好的地图演出 (感谢英俊Seth哥).
重置游戏逻辑以适应CS2
<游戏所有流程与go的v1版本无任何差异>
<尼赫仑斯boss战将在未来更新加入>
